title: (PDF) Rapamycin extends life- and health span because it slows aging
abstract:
And what is aging if not an increase of the probability of death with age. I discuss that the JCI paper actually shows that rapamycin slows aging and also extends lifespan regardless of its effects on cancer.
Making headlines, a thought-provocative paper by Neff F, Ehninger D and coworkers claims that rapamycin extends life span but has limited effects on aging. How is that possibly possible? And what is aging if not an increase of the probability of death with age. I discuss that the JCI paper actually shows that rapamycin slows aging and also extends lifespan regardless of its effects on cancer.
